name: Probing for Surface Mesh Generation through Delaunay Refinement
aliases: Probing for Surface Mesh Generation through Delaunay Refinement algorithm
definition: An algorithm to generate a surface mesh without requiring an initial point set, using Delaunay refinement and a probing procedure to ensure all connected components of the surface are meshed. It guarantees topological equivalence to the surface and approximation properties defined by the refinement algorithm.
summary: This method generates surface meshes from implicit surfaces without initial points by autonomously discovering isolated components through spatial probing combined with Delaunay refinement.
